posts.author: Arcaines
posts.body:
So Not sure what makes the question unique? It seems to be like a resource request.
Which shouldn't be too hard to do at all.
But you are requesting a lot of resources which is going to take a long time to do and I'm doubt anyone is going to do that for free for you.
I've requested battler sheets for 4 characters and that took 1 month to do.
What are you offering in return for all these resources?
Assuming their all custom made?
If not, like the tilesets, you could ask if there is any already some on the interweb somewhere.
